title: Liya Kedar colour mode: flat fills and navy-outlined shapes
note: Hovering 'color' fills the header with lilac #F1B8FF and the statement band with yellow #F6E23E. Each column turns a flat colour (#86C177 leaf, #4C6A82 slate, #A8D8F7 sky, #F3963D tangerine, #E9D8A6 sand) and its photo is replaced by the object's silhouette as a flat shape in a second colour with a 2px navy outline: a rectangle for the magazine card, a rounded phone, a tin, an app icon, a T-shirt. Labels get their own fills (#F08C82, #A9C23E, #C7ADEB, #D8493A, #7FBFB0). The 2px navy rules and navy type never change, which keeps 15 colours from turning to mush. Worth reusing: one constant ink colour for every line and letter lets you go wild with fills.
